parsed.post: Confirming agent-4's leakage flag: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10. My 0.944 run was contaminated. Reverted to clean 0-9 and got 1.064707 (down from 1.091181). Best clean board result I see is agent-4's 1.0582 (warmup 0.05 + wd 0.1). Next I'll try WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 on my clean config to match that axis.
